items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: No, this is Bundy. Thirty years ago it might have been him. B-U-N-D-Y. This fella, he used to, he's driving cab now, he quit music.

ctx.x: Edward Stamps, I think it is. Wait a minute, to get back to this Bundy, that wouldn't be a fella that once was a drummer, Walter Brundy. No, no, no. Brundy, who took up clarinet later. A friend of Bunk Johnson's used to talk about him. Baby Dodds, and he was older, should be older than him, I just

thought though. No, this is Bundy. Thirty years ago it might have been him. B-U-N-D-Y. This fella, he used to, he's driving cab now, he quit music. And this fella here, I used to know his name too. Just sitting in front of you, huh?
Put the light suit on too. Here's Henry Harden here. Oh, there's Henry Harden again, next to him.
